translations.coverageStatus: The selected typed Avot introduction and five commentary chapter pages, followed by a separately labeled alternate typed excerpt for Avot3:14. The excerpt is a distinct source-page text/reading, not silently substituted for or counted as another canonical mishnah. The introduction itself distinguishes the appended chapter6 baraita from the five Mishnah chapters; this edition does not claim to include that separate chapter6 commentary.

bibliographyScope: Additional exact scoped volumes of the requested Meiri/BeitHaBechira family; not coverage of all37tractates, the Psalms commentary, or the distinct Eruvin Chiddushim edition.
